text:
Anya: Two weeks out from GA — we need a concrete gate list to sign off. Must cover SLA (p99 latency & uptime), docs (quickstart + API diffs), support (oncall + escalation), monitoring (alerts + dashboards), pricing (tiers & burst). Who owns what?
Mike: I can own SLA perf targets + runbook. Quick q: hosted p99 under load target 200ms or 300ms?
Elaine: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated looks feasible; Hosted should be 99.9% for GA. For p99 I recommend soft 300ms / hard 500ms so we have wiggle room. :thinking_face:
Kat: I'll own docs. Need API diff list and migration notes from eng by EOD Mon. Also want a short quickstart + code snippets.
Sam: On pricing — want simple tiering: dev / standard / enterprise + burst credits. Can finance sign off on provisional GA rates? We can call them "intro" rates.
Ryan: Legal: SLA binding language needs exceptions for force majeure, maintenance windows, and Private deployment residency clauses. Send draft SLA and I'll add wording.
Jen: Ops/support: propose 24/7 oncall for first 72h post-GA, then follow SLO-driven rotation. We need runbook links and escalation matrix in docs.
Mike: I'll run the load tests Wed/Thu and post results. If p99 exceeds 300ms, I want permission to open a soft-gate and enable burst capacity temporarily.
Anya: Sounds good. Action owners: SLA -> Mike + Elaine, Docs -> Kat, Pricing -> Sam + Finance, Legal SLA wording -> Ryan, Support rota + runbooks -> Jen. I'll track in the GA board.
Kat: Quick note on docs scope: include "what's changed" section for SDK users and a migration table for any param renames. Will add templates for Support.
Elaine: Monitoring: need dashboards for p50/p95/p99, error rate, token cost per request, KV cache hit rate. Alerts: p99>500ms, error rate >1% over 5m, token-cost delta >20%.
Jen: Adding escalation steps: page SRE -> 30m, page Eng lead -> 45m, page Product -> 60m. Also, ops runbook should include fallback model variants and cross-region failover steps.
Sam: For pricing I need estimated unit economics from Mike (tokens/sec cost) to propose burst pricing. Also confirm whether Dedicated customers get flat rate vs metered.
Mike: Will dump perf-cost numbers after the run. Also posting a snippet for the SLA table we can embed in docs:
```
SLA: Hosted - 99.9% uptime, p99 soft=300ms / hard=500ms
Dedicated - 99.95% uptime, p99 soft=250ms / hard=400ms
```
Kat: Perfect, I'll use that as the source of truth for the docs.
Ryan: Please tag me on the final SLA draft. Also asking Legal for a short standard clause for pilot customers vs GA customers.
Anya: Two quick remaining questions: 1) Freeze API surface date? 2) Do we require an opt-in for early enterprise customers to sign SOWs?
Mike: Freeze API surface by Mon (EOD) so docs can lock.
Sam: For enterprise, yes — require SOWs and custom pricing. We should allow early enterprise pilots under NDA but with explicit SOW.
Kat: I'll schedule a docs freeze PR review on Mon morning.
Elaine: I'll schedule the load window and make sure feature flags for fallbacks are tested.
Jen: I'll draft the oncall rota and attach the runbook link once Mike posts perf artifacts.
Anya: Great — I'll create a GH issue tracking all these owners and a checklist. If anyone needs to change owners, ping me here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging succeeded (commit 9f3a2b1).
Mike: Thanks — will attach perf logs to the GH issue after tests.
Kat: noted, will prepare doc skeleton now.
Anya: Closing loop: next sync Thurs 10am to review run results and PRs. If blockers pop up before then, drop them in this thread.
